name: proforma-mcp

tools.name: add_argument
tools.description: Add an argument (rule) to a decision candidate: support for/against/confirming/excluding (symbolic decisions) or a numeric weight (numeric decisions), a condition expression, optional name and caption.

condition.description: Condition expression under which the argument applies

support.description: Support: for, against, confirming, excluding (symbolic) or a number/expression (numeric)

tools.name: add_attributes
tools.description: Insert attributes or nested elements written as PROforma text into a component or nested element, e.g. a candidate with arguments into a decision, a source into an enquiry, a warning_condition into a data item.

pf.description: PROforma attribute text, e.g. `candidate :: 'refer'; caption :: 'Refer'; argument :: for, risk = high; recommendation :: netsupport(triage, refer) > 0;`

tools.name: add_candidate
tools.description: Add a candidate (option) to a decision with caption, recommendation rule (default `netsupport() > 0`) and priority.

tools.name: add_component
tools.description: Add a component to a plan that reuses an existing task definition, optionally after other components and with extra component attributes (optional, cycles, param_value).

after.description: Components in the same plan that must complete first

name.description: Component name (defaults to the task definition name)

pf.description: Extra component attributes as PROforma text, e.g. `optional :: yes; cycle_repeat :: 1 days;`

plan.description: Plan that will contain the component

tools.name: add_data_item
tools.description: Add a data item with type, caption and optional range, default value, derivation and unit.

range.description: Allowed values as PROforma text, e.g. `"low", "high"` or `0, 120`

type.description: Type: text, integer, real, boolean, date, time, datetime, setof_text, setof_integer, setof_real

tools.name: add_source
tools.description: Add a data source to an enquiry (or decision): the data item whose value is requested. Can create the data item with create_type.

create_type.description: Create the data item with this type if it does not exist (text, integer, real, boolean, date, ...)

mandatory.description: Whether a value is mandatory (default yes)

tools.name: add_task
tools.description: Create a task (plan, decision, action, enquiry or generic task) inside a plan: adds the task definition and a component with the same name, optionally scheduled after other components and with a caption/precondition.

after.description: Components in the same plan that must complete first (schedule constraints)

kind.description: Task kind: plan, decision, action, enquiry or task

ltwh.description: Layout as "left,top" or "left,top,width,height" (default: below the last sibling)

name.description: Task name (identifier); also used as the component name

plan.description: Plan that will contain the task

tools.name: check_expression
tools.description: Parse and type-check an expression (optionally against a .pf file): reports syntax errors, the inferred type, what each name resolves to, and verifier warnings. Use before setting preconditions, recommendations, arguments or derivations.

assertion.description: Parse as an assertion (postcondition / param_value syntax: `x = e and y := f`)

expression.description: The expression, e.g. `age >= 18 and result_of(triage) = urgent`

file.description: Optional .pf file used to resolve names and types

tools.name: create_guideline
tools.description: Create a new, valid PROforma 1.9 guideline file (engine_version, metadata, metaprops and an empty root plan).

file.description: Path of the .pf file to create

title.description: Human-readable title (used for metadata title and root caption)

tools.name: find_references
tools.description: Find every reference to a task, data item, function or component name: plan components, scheduling constraints, sources and expressions.

name.description: Task, data item, function or component name

tools.name: format
tools.description: Rewrite a file in Deontics Composer's canonical layout (CRLF, 5-space indent, fixed attribute order) and upgrade legacy files to engine_version 1.9. With check=true only reports whether it is formatted.

check.description: Only check; do not modify the file

print.description: Return the formatted text instead of writing the file

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Get a component or nested element as PROforma text (default) or JSON. Selectors: `name`, `plan/component:x`, `decision/candidate:c`, `decision/candidate:c/argument:1`, `enquiry/source:s`, `data/warning_condition:1`.

tools.name: lint
tools.description: Validate a guideline like Deontics Composer does (syntax, Composer compatibility, reference resolution, verifier type checks with the engine's own messages) plus extra checks (scheduling cycles, recursive plans, unknown candidates/tasks, crash-prone constructs). Codes: PF-L syntax, PF-K Composer compatibility (fix with format), PF-C/R/PP/G engine load checks, PF-V verifier, PF-X extra.

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List top-level components (plans, decisions, actions, enquiries, tasks, data items, functions) with kind, caption, type and line. Optional kind and substring filters.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on name or caption

kind.description: Only this kind: plan, decision, action, enquiry, task, data or function

tools.name: outline
tools.description: Overview of a guideline: metadata, the task tree from the root plan (with scheduling and decision candidates), data items and functions. Start here.

tools.name: plan_graph
tools.description: Return a plan's graph as JSON: components (task instances) with kind, caption, layout, flags and the components they wait for.

plan.description: Plan name (defaults to the root plan)

tools.name: proforma_reference
tools.description: Return the PROforma language reference: file structure, task kinds, decisions, data items, expression operators, built-in functions and editing conventions. Read this before writing PROforma text.

section.description: Optional section: overview, syntax, tasks, decisions, data, expressions, functions, editing. Omit for everything.

tools.name: remove_attribute
tools.description: Remove all attributes with the given keyword from a component or nested element.

tools.name: remove_component
tools.description: Remove a top-level task, data item or function. Cascades by default: plan components using it, constraints on those components and sources reading a removed data item are removed; remaining expression references are reported.

no_cascade.description: Keep plan components / sources that reference it (leaves dangling references)

tools.name: remove_element
tools.description: Remove a nested element by selector: a plan component (`plan/component:x`, also drops constraints on it), candidate, source, argument or warning condition.

selector.description: Selector of the nested element, e.g. `triage/candidate:refer/argument:2`

tools.name: rename
tools.description: Rename a task, data item or function and update all references (task_definition, scheduling constraints, sources, expressions). Use `plan/component:x` to rename only a component instance.

name.description: Current name, or `Plan/component:Name` for a component instance

tools.name: schedule_constraint
tools.description: Add (or remove) a scheduling constraint: `component` starts only after `after` has completed. Both must be components of the same plan; self-loops, duplicates and cycles are rejected.

remove.description: Remove the constraint instead of adding it

tools.name: search
tools.description: Case-insensitive search across names, captions, descriptions and expressions.

tools.name: set_attribute
tools.description: Set one attribute on a component or nested element (replaces an existing value). The value is PROforma text after `attribute ::` (captions/descriptions may be plain text). E.g. precondition='age >= 18', recommendation='netsupport() > 0', caption='Assess patient', choice_mode='multiple', optional='yes', cycle_repeat='1 days'.

attribute.description: Attribute keyword, e.g. caption, description, precondition, wait_condition, recommendation, type, range, default_value, derivation, unit, mandatory, optional, cycle_repeat, ...

value.description: Value as PROforma text (without the trailing ';')

tools.name: set_metadata
tools.description: Set guideline metadata: title, desc, author, version, cdate, mdate.

tools.name: to_mermaid
tools.description: Export a plan as a Mermaid flowchart: node shape per task kind (action rounded, enquiry diamond, decision circle, plan stadium/subgraph, task trapezoid), scheduling arrows, decision branch labels inferred from result_of preconditions, optional candidate and data nodes.

data.description: Draw enquiry/decision data sources as data nodes

depth.description: Maximum sub-plan nesting depth in expanded mode (default 8)

direction.description: Flowchart direction: auto (default, from ltwh layout), TD or LR

label.description: Node labels: both (default), name or caption

mode.description: expanded (default; sub-plans become nested subgraphs) or drilldown (one level, like Composer's plan editor)

output.description: Write the diagram to this file instead of returning it (.mmd or .md; .md wraps it in a ```mermaid fence)

plan.description: Plan to render (defaults to the root plan)

tools.name: upsert_component
tools.description: Add or replace whole top-level components written as PROforma text (e.g. `decision :: 'triage'; ... end decision.`). Several blocks may be given; a block replaces the existing component with the same name. Note: adding a task definition does not put it in a plan (use add_component or add_task).

pf.description: One or more complete blocks (plan/decision/action/enquiry/task/data/function ... end X.)

instructions: Tools for PROforma clinical guideline files (.pf, Deontics Composer format). Every tool takes the file path; the file on disk is the source of truth. Start with `outline`, read `proforma_reference` before writing PROforma text, use `check_expression` to validate expressions, prefer the structured edit tools (add_task, add_candidate, add_argument, add_source, add_data_item, schedule_constraint, set_attribute), and run `lint` after edits. `to_mermaid` renders plans as diagrams.
